title: Mark Zuckerberg texted Elon Musk to offer help with DOGE | TechCrunch
summary: Elon Musk and Mark Zuckerberg had a warming relationship by early 2025, as evidenced by their text exchanges discussing government efficiency and potential collaboration on OpenAI. Zuckerberg showed support for Musk's initiatives but did not commit to joining his bid for OpenAI.
